race.comment: FIERCE (9) lightly raced gelding building a good winning CV. Shouldered the 60.5kg second up from the outside draw with a tenacious second over 1100m at Canterbury in BM72 grade. Has the ability to raise the bar and sure to go close with the fitness edge. KUJENGA (14) resumes after she failed to come up in three runs over the autumn. Fitted with the two trials on the country tracks and can sprint well fresh with the claim. Value contender. MERCY ME (10) showed blistering speed from the outset first-up with a narrow third over 1100m at this track. Comes to hand quickly and assess on her good Denise's Joy placing. KIMBERLEY SECRETS (6) is deep into the prep and place best from the ugly draw. ELLIPSIS (13) good fresh mare resuming. Can give some of these a fright after the two solid trials.
